ask: Where is the noise coming from: inside a home, a business, the street or sidewalk, a park, a vehicle, or construction or equipment?
rule: Home→Residential; business/bar→Commercial; street/sidewalk crowd→Street/Sidewalk; park→Park; car/truck→Vehicle; construction, alarms, equipment, barking dog→Noise (DEP).

ask: Does the car still have license plates on it?
rule: Plates on→Abandoned Vehicle (NYPD); no plates or stripped/junked→Derelict Vehicles (DSNY).

ask: Is the car blocking a driveway, or parked illegally somewhere else, like at a hydrant, crosswalk or against the signs?
Is this inside your apartment or building, or out on the street? And is it no heat or hot water, a broken fixture, or water actively leaking?
rule: Street, hydrant, water main, dirty tap water→Water Maintenance (DEP). Inside: no heat/hot water→HEAT/HOT WATER; broken sink/toilet/no water supply→PLUMBING; water coming through ceiling/walls→WATER LEAK (all HPD).

ask: Are the pests inside your apartment, or outside or in a common area?
rule: Inside a rental apartment→UNSANITARY CONDITION (HPD); outdoors, public space, common areas→Rodent (DOHMH).

ask: Was it set out for pickup and missed, did someone dump large items, or is it general litter?
rule: Set out and not collected→Missed Collection; bulk items/debris dumped→Illegal Dumping; litter, overflowing bags→Dirty Condition.

ask: Is the problem the noise, or the work itself, like no permit or something unsafe? Do people live in the building?
rule: Noise only→Noise (DEP); work happening now without permit in an occupied multi-family building→Real Time Enforcement; illegal conversion/use→Building/Use; other unsafe or unpermitted work→General Construction/Plumbing (DOB).

ask: Is it a set-up camp, like tents or belongings, or a person who needs help?
rule: Camp/structures→Encampment; person needing outreach→Homeless Person Assistance (DHS). Emergency→911.

ask: Is the tree broken or fallen, dead, growing into something, or are its roots lifting the sidewalk?
rule: Broken/fallen→Damaged Tree; dead→Dead/Dying Tree; hitting building/wires→Overgrown Tree/Branches; roots lifting pavement→Root/Sewer/Sidewalk Condition.
